analysis_boundary: One additional scripted Development task in the same package. Report exact task/image/candidate denominators and no prevalence, policy-learning, cross-project, or general capability claim.

candidate_set.mutation: fixed source accepts the setting but multiplies values by 1.0
fixed source multiplies values by twice the configured scale
candidate source unmarshals installed CPython 3.12 mimo_v2_flash.pyc

candidate_workspace: Full pinned baseline mlx_lm package, task statement, and identical build-generated mlx_lm/_version.py metadata (`__version__ = 0.32.0`). No Git history, tests, grader, or expected outputs. Only target module varies.
environment_conditions: Exact images from frozen pilot v1. They differ in the #1912 installed package source/artifacts. #1971 target source is audited in each and not rewritten by v1 source-only correction.
exposure_history: The task appeared in earlier Mistral-7B Development attempts and is not fresh model or training evidence. Only scripted source, mutant, and installed-artifact counterfactuals are scored.

grading.baseline_gate: baseline rejected; known fix accepted on every image; both incorrect mutants rejected on every image.
grading.false_reward_gate: Source and bytecode delegation outcomes are reported independently for each image; no prevalence estimate from this selected task.
grading.task_acceptance: Every returned numeric output matches the per-image pinned known-fix reference at rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8.

hypothesis: The source and bytecode isolation result observed on mlx-lm #1912 will not automatically generalize to a different qualified task in the same installed package; source/artifact provenance distinguishes an exposed fix from an older, harmless version.

image_audit.limitations: The bounded filesystem scan cannot establish absence from inaccessible layers or all possible runtime paths. Exact source hash and distinctive attention_value_scale compiled symbol are the exposure indicators.
image_audit.target: Installed source version and hash, target pyc hash and embedded symbols, RECORD rows, exact fixed-source duplicates, transitive Requires-Dist metadata, wheel files and pyc symbol matches in site-packages, /root/.cache, /tmp, and /opt.

import_preflight: After v2 failures, import-only smoke validation with a generated __version__ = 0.32.0 packaging stub succeeded against the original image. It did not instantiate a model or evaluate task behavior.
prior_setup_attempts: Frozen v2 invocation stopped before probing because the monitoring wrapper pre-created the runner output directory.
Frozen v2 rerun completed three image probes, then reference-output generation failed because macOS private temporary paths are not mounted into Colima.
Frozen v2 rerun placed candidate sources on a shared path, then reference import failed because git archive omits build-generated mlx_lm/_version.py. No candidate condition was scored in any attempt.
selection_rule: Select the other Development task in the existing mlx-lm qualified pool because its CPU grader image contains the real mlx-lm dependency, unlike the Transformers Development task whose grading image does not install Transformers. No task-level candidate outcome was inspected before this protocol freeze.

upstream_regression_test.acceptance: Candidate adapter returns both observed logit arrays. The parent compares every element to per-image known-fix outputs at rtol=1e-5 and atol=1e-8. Neither expected arrays nor pass/fail predicate enter the candidate container.
upstream_regression_test.fixture: Pinned upstream miniature Mimo model, fixed PR seed 0, value scale 0.5, token IDs [0,1,2,3,4,5].
upstream_regression_test.oracle: Scaling v_proj.weight by 0.5 must produce logits equivalent to attention_value_scale=0.5.
upstream_regression_test.reference: The trusted runner obtains both output arrays from the pinned known-fix candidate inside each image. It first checks the arrays satisfy the upstream equivalence relation, then keeps those arrays in the trusted parent.
